build_fast_rcnn_detector: build a FastRCNN detector with a backbone, roi_head, train_cfg, and test_cfg config
run_fast_rcnn_inference: run the FastRCNN detector to predict bounding boxes and labels on input images
train_fast_rcnn_model: train the FastRCNN model by calling loss() with batch inputs and ground truth data samples
extract_fast_rcnn_features: extract multi-level features from images using the backbone and optional neck of FastRCNN
review_fast_rcnn_init: review the FastRCNN __init__ to understand how backbone, roi_head, and config are wired together
